name: AstaBench
intro: AstaBench 是一个用于评估科学研究 Agent 的可复现套件，由 11 个基准、2,404 道验证与测试题组成，覆盖文献理解、代码与执行、数据分析、端到端发现四类能力。它提供受控的 Asta 科学语料检索与有状态 Python Notebook 环境，并在统一框架下比较 22 类共 57 个 Agent 的任务表现、成本与工具配置。
build_method: 已部署 Asta 产品需求驱动, 既有与新建科学评测整合, 答案可验证性过滤, 受控工具环境
metric: 基准特定准确率/完成率, 标准差, 美元成本, 准确率-成本 Pareto 前沿
task_type: Agent任务, 代码生成, Data Analysis
eval_feature: 领域特定, 过程导向, 工具增强, 成本归一化, 工具配置分层
scale: 2,404道验证与测试题，覆盖11个基准和4类科学研究能力
drawio_review_note: REDRAW review aligned with AstaBench arXiv:2510.21652v2 Section 3, Table 2, Sections 4.1-4.3, Appendices E and F, and official repository snapshot 36c9.... Product requests plus existing and newly created evaluations are adapted or filtered into exactly 11 benchmarks and 2,404 validation/test items. Table 2 binds PaperFindingBench, LitQA2-FullText-Search, ScholarQA-CS2, and LitQA2-FullText to Corpus tools; ArxivDIGESTables-Clean alone to the paper-ID-restricted Snippet tool; and SUPER-Expert, CORE-Bench-Hard-minus, DS-1000, DiscoveryBench, E2E-Bench, and E2E-Bench-Hard to Code tools. Agents and compatible tool configurations are selected before only applicable agent-task combinations are executed. Outputs then feed task scores, frozen cost accounting, and the accuracy-cost Pareto report.
task_type_en: Agent Task, Code Generation, Data Analysis
build_method_en: Deployed-Asta product needs, integration of existing and new scientific evaluations, answerability filtering, controlled tool environments
intro_en: AstaBench is a reproducible scientific-research agent suite containing 2,404 validation and test questions across 11 benchmarks and four capability groups: literature understanding, code and execution, data analysis, and end-to-end discovery. It supplies controlled Asta scientific-corpus search and stateful Python notebook environments, then compares task performance, cost, and tool configurations for 57 agents across 22 classes.
